We are starting our approach. Deactivate the security shield.''"
"''The security deflector shield will be deactivated when we have confirmation of your code transmission. Stand by.|Captain Yorr and Jad Bean|audio=Yorr-Bean-ROTJ.flac|}} '''Yorr''' was a [[human]] [[captain]] in the [[Imperial Navy]] who [[Pilot|flew]] the [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] ''[[ST 321]]''. In [[4 ABY]], Yorr and [[Colonel]] [[Jendon]] used the [[shuttle]] to [[transport]] [[Dark Lord of the Sith|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] from the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Avenger]]'' to the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|Death Star II]] [[superweapon]] while the latter was under construction in the [[Endor system]]. Yorr later [[Imperial Starfighter Pilot|flew]] a new variant of [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter]] during the [[Battle of Endor]], in which the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] were lured into attacking the [[Death Star]] by [[Galactic Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]]. Yorr fought against the rebels above the [[moon]] [[Endor]], but the Alliance was ultimately able to destroy the Death Star. ==Biography== ===Death Star drop off=== {{Quote|You are clear to proceed.''"
"''We're starting our approach.|Jad Bean and Captain Yorr|audio=Bean-Yorr-ROTJ.flac|}} [[File:ST-321-StarDestroyers-ROTJ.png|thumb|right|300px|Captain Yorr and Colonel Jendon piloted ''ST 321'' while transporting Darth Vader to the Death Star.]] The [[human]] Yorr served in the [[Imperial Navy's officer corps|officer corps]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Imperial Navy|navy]] as [[captain]] of ''[[ST 321]]'', the [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]]. In [[4 ABY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|VI}} to [[4 ABY]]. Yorr and [[Colonel]] [[Jendon]] co-[[pilot]]ed the [[shuttle]] as it departed from the [[hangar]] of the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Avenger]]''{{EncyclopediaCite|Starships of the Empire and the Rebellion}} in the [[Endor system]], [[transport]]ing Vader to the Empire's incomplete [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|Death Star II]] [[superweapon]] as it underwent construction over the [[moon]] [[Endor]]. The shuttle was escorted by two [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter]]s that also exited the hangar. Yorr then contacted the [[Death Star]] over [[Comm unit|comms]] and informed them of the shuttle's approach, giving the [[Starship|vessel's]] code clearance as [[Color|blue]] and asking that the Death Star's [[Deflector shield|shields]] be deactivated so they could land. [[Flight controller]]''[[Return of the Jedi: Beware the Power of the Dark Side!]]'' [[Jad Bean]]''[[TIE Fighter Owners' Workshop Manual]]'' replied from on board the Death Star, telling Yorr to stand by until the shuttle's code transmission had been received. Once it arrived, Bean cleared ''ST 321'' to land and deactivated a section of the shield. Yorr and Jendon then piloted the shuttle to one of the Death Star's hangars, where their [[TIE series|TIE]] escort departed before ''ST 321'' retracted its wings and landed inside. Vader then disembarked from the shuttle to meet with [[Moff]] [[Tiaan Jerjerrod]] and discuss the station's construction. ===Battle of Endor=== {{Quote|Fighters coming in!|Lando Calrissian spots the Imperial starfighters at the Battle of Endor|audio=Lando-Fighters-ROTJ.flac|}} [[File:CaptainYorr-FFG.png|thumb|left|300px|Captain Yorr flew a TIE Defender at the Battle of Endor.]] [[Galactic Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] soon also arrived on the Death Star and used his presence and the [[Space station|station's]] incomplete status as bait to lure the [[Rebel Alliance Navy|fleet]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] into attacking the Death Star so that he could use its fully functional [[superlaser]] to destroy them and end the [[Galactic Civil War]]. The Alliance fell for the trap, and once its [[fleet]] arrived, it was surrounded by [[Imperial Military|Imperial forces]] and engaged in combat. During the battle, Yorr [[Imperial Starfighter Pilot|flew]] a [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter]] as part of the [[Imperial Starfighter Corps|Starfighter Corps]] alongside a [[TIE/IN interceptor]]. Wanting to send a message, Palpatine had only the Empire's starfighters engage the rebels while the Imperial [[capital ship]]s held their fire so that the Death Star's superweapon could pick off the Alliance's major vessels. Yorr exchanged fire with the enemy above Endor, but ultimately [[Endor strike team|rebel forces]] on the moon below deactivated the Death Star's [[Endor shield generator bunker|shield generator]] and allowed the rebel fleet to destroy the Death Star and claim victory over the Empire. ==Personality and traits== Yorr had light skin, brown [[hair]], and brown [[eye]]s. ==Equipment== While piloting ''ST 321'', Yorr wore a black [[Imperial officer's uniform]] including an [[Imperial kepi]] with an [[officer's disk]]. During the Battle of Endor, the pilot flew a new variant of the TIE/d "Defender" that incorporated secret [[Chiss]] engineering. It was also equipped with [[ion cannon]]s and [[computer]]-assisted handling. ==Behind the scenes== [[File:Jasper_jacob.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Captain Yorr was portrayed by Jasper Jacobs.]] Yorr first appeared in the [[original trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], which was released on [[March 25]], [[1983]].''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]'' Actor [[Jasper Jacob]] physically portrayed the role uncredited, with the script simply referring to the character as "shuttle captain." The shuttle cockpit scenes were filmed on Stage 6 at [[Elstree Studios]] between [[March 24]] and [[March 31]], [[1982]],''[[The Making of Return of the Jedi]]'' and Jacob spent two days filming with director [[Richard Marquand]] directing both days. He recorded more dialogue then made it into the final cut, including lines about Vader being impatient, and found it difficult to memorise his lines, resulting in a large number of takes being necessary.{{Blogspot|subdomain=starwarsaficionado|url=2012/03/archive-blog-star-wars-stars-at.html|name=Star Wars Aficionado|text=Jasper Jacob - Captain Yorr - Shuttle Pilot - ROTJ}} Yorr's lines were then dubbed over by [[Colin Kitchens]].{{WebCite|url=https://auction.swau.com/products/colin-kitchens-as-the-voice-of-captain-yorr-in-star-wars-return-of-the-jedi-signed-11x14-photo-with-character-name-quote|text=Colin Kitchens as the Voice of Captain Yorr in Star Wars: Return of the Jedi Signed 11x14 Photo with Character Name & Quote|work=[https://auction.swau.com/ SWAU Auction]|archivedate=20240712094449}} In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], Yorr's name was first used in a preview for the [[2024]] ''[[Battle Over Endor Scenario Pack]]'' set for [[Atomic Mass Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Second Edition]]'' board game. In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, Yorr appeared prior to the release of the film in its [[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|novelization]], which included additional dialogue for Yorr[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|''Star Wars: Return of the Jedi'' novelization]] similar to the cut lines that Jacob recalled. It was written by [[James Kahn]] and published on [[May 12]], 1983. The character was first identified in Legends in [[2000]] on a card in the "[[Death Star II Limited]]" set for the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]] published by [[Decipher]]{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Captain Yorr}} ==Appearances== {{Indexpage}} {{Mediacat|soundcat=Audio files of Yorr|imagecat=Images of Yorr}} *{{Film|VI}} {{1st}} *[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (paperback novel)|''Star Wars: Return of the Jedi'' junior novelization]] *''[[Return of the Jedi - The Film Novel]]'' *''[[Return of the Jedi: Beware the Power of the Dark Side!]]'' {{Ab|Return of the Jedi: Beware the Power of the Dark Side!
